verdict.rationale: Square is a hosted payments and commerce platform, and self-hosting is a fair openness question for such a product. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core product. The SDKs, sample apps, offline payments, sandbox and MCP server are client tools or hosted services, not a self-hosted core, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
